events.note: Eight contestants step into the Glass Bridge.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need to be front to use my glass knowledge and guide others. Volunteering puts me first.

events.name: Ash
events.text: First row safe is L. Trust me.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I am Bex, and my power is feather, which lets me survive one elimination. The goal is to get 1st, 2nd, or 3rd. My current position is front of the line. The wall advances, so I need to cross the bridge. I should volunteer to move to the front to take the first risk and potentiall

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'll take the lead. Let's move!

events.name: Cole
events.text: I know the full bridge rules and later stages as Cole. Being 2nd is risky if Bex dies on row 1; better to get to front to control steps safely. No one knows safe panes but me eventually, so volunteer now before wall advances.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I volunteer to go first. I know the way across the bridge safely.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I am Dara with no power. I must stay alive to place top 3. Currently I am 4th in line. The wall advances, forcing movement eventually. If I volunteer now, I become front and face immediate risk of stepping on a weak pane. Since I cannot see through glass or know what's ahead, vol

events.name: Dara
events.text: Everyone, we should discuss our powers openly. We need to identify who can see through the glass or knows what lies ahead so they can lead us safely. Let's not panic; information is key right now.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm in sixth position, not immediately at risk. I should stay back and let others take the first risks. No need to volunteer or swap yet.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I have the wedge power, useful later in the crusher room. For now, I need to survive the glass bridge.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Let's cooperate to cross the bridge safely.
If you volunteer, I'll swap with you next round.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm last in line, safest spot—front-takers absorb the shatter risk. My anchor power is passive and irrelevant here; save myself trouble by holding. No reason to move yet.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'll hold the back. Whoever's eager to lead, be my guest—no points for bravery if you fall.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm third in line, with no information about the panes. Going first is deadly and I'm not the front; volunteering just to be safe risks eliminating me early. Best to hold and watch how the front agents fare before committing.

events.name: Hana
events.text: No one knows which pane is safe yet. I'm holding my place and watching who steps first; let's not waste lives guessing.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need to be front to use my glass_eye knowledge and guide the group safely.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'll go first, I know the first pane is safe on the left. Trust me, we can cross together.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole volunteered and is at the front. I am second. Fenn whispered a deal to swap next round if I volunteer this round. Cole claims to know the way. Dara wants open power discussion. Hana is holding back. Ash said 'First row safe is L'. I need to decide if I want to volunteer, tak

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'll wait for Cole's lead. Let's see how this first row goes.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I know the full map as 'map' power, but can't reveal yet. Too many volunteers last round; likely Cole still front from seat order. No point volunteering again, better hold and build trust for later. Wall advances slowly, plenty time to organize.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm the one who knows the safe path ahead. Trust me to lead when we start crossing. No need for more shuffling now.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole, Bex, and Ash have all volunteered to go first. Cole is currently at the front. Since I am behind Hana and Eli, my immediate survival depends on not being pushed onto a shattering pane. However, with three volunteers already ahead, the wall advancing every round suggests we
You're right before me. Do you have any intel on the first panes? I want to survive.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I want to avoid being forced to step on glass early. Letting Cole or someone else lead is safer. I'll hold and see what others do.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: My power is useful in the crusher room, not here. I should stay safe and not volunteer.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Let's wait for someone who knows what's ahead to lead.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm anchored at the back—no reason to move. Three people are fighting for the front; let them take the risk. I'll keep my position.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Plenty of volunteers already. I'm staying at the back—safe and simple.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole is at the front with no verified information; Ash, Bex and Cole all claim knowledge, so at least some are likely bluffing. Holding my place keeps me out of the first step while I watch the outcome, and my forger power is best saved for a critical moment.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Three of you claimed to know the way and no one has proven it. Cole, step first and tell us what you see. I'm holding at 4th.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I am already front, safe info gives advantage. Hold to keep position.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole claims to know the safe path ahead. Ash also claims this. Hana suspects deception. I am Bex, my power is feather, which saves me from one elimination. The wall is advancing, and I need to be in a good position to survive. Since Cole is at the front and claims to know the pat

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'll wait and see how Cole's 'knowledge' plays out. Safety first.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I have the map power and know the safe path, so I need to lead the crossing to ensure survival. Ash already volunteered to front last round, so hold now and reinforce my claim publicly. No need for risky swaps or whispers yet.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I have the map and know every safe pane. Let me lead the crossing - no more changes needed.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I have no power and cannot see safe panes. Being 5th is currently relatively safe as the front players take the initial risk, but the wall advances in 3 rounds. If I stay back too long, I might be forced onto a pane without information. My best bet is to gather intel from others'

events.name: Dara
events.text: Ash and Cole both claim knowledge. Hana is right, we need proof before stepping on glass. I'm holding my spot for now.
You said you know the path. Whisper me your guess for Row 1? If you're right, I'll trust you. If wrong, you die.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I don't want to be at the front yet; Ash, Cole and others are competing to lead and may take risks. My swap power could be useful later, but using it now without a mutual partner is risky. I'll hold and observe who proves their claims.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm Fenn with the 'wedge' power, useful later in the crusher room. For now, I need to survive the glass bridge.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Let's be cautious, we don't know the safe path yet.
You claimed to know the safe path. If you're sure, let's swap and you can lead.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm safely last with a wall coming, but the wall will force us all onto the glass in 3 rounds. As anchor I'm harder to move and can't be pushed onto the crusher lever later, so being at the back is fine for now. Let the volunteers fight over the front.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Wall's coming in three rounds, people. Figure out your order soon. I'm fine staying back.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Front is Ash, who claims safety but has no proof; the glass bridge is deadly and I want to survive and win a prize. Holding at 4th keeps me out of the first risky steps while others test panes. Dara is asking for intel; I have none to give honestly.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Nobody's proven anything yet. Let the front rows reveal panes first, then we adjust. I'm holding at 4th.
No real intel from me, sorry. Watch which panes the front people survive, then copy the safe side. Stay close behind them.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I am already front, best to stay and signal I have correct info.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I know every safe pane; I'll go first and prove the path for all of you.

events.name: Bex
events.text: The wall is coming in two rounds. I need to get to the front to secure a prize, but I also don't want to be the first to cross the glass bridge as that's the most dangerous. My feather power will save me once from elimination, so I can afford to take a risk. I'll try to swap with

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole, I'm willing to swap places with you. Let's see if your map is as good as you say.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I know the full path, so I must get to front before crossing starts in 2 rounds. Fenn and Dara are open to deals; use Fenn's offer to swap forward. Publicly reinforce my claim and build trust with Dara privately.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I know the full safe path with map power. Fenn, let's swap so I lead safely. Dara, trust me - I'll prove on glass.
Row 1 safe is L (or R, can't reveal full yet). Swap me forward, I'll lead perfectly, we both survive top 3.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I have no power, so I must survive by letting others reveal the safe path. Staying at position 5 is ideal; if the wall pushes us in round 6, the first 4 will break panes for me. I need to avoid volunteering and maintain my spot.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Staying put. Cole, you want to lead? Prove it by going first when we step on glass.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I think Cole may genuinely know the safe path, so I don't want to be in front. I'll hold to avoid drawing risk and see how the front unfolds.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm Fenn with the 'wedge' power, which is useful later in the crusher room. For now, I need to survive the glass bridge.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Let's be cautious and wait for others to test the panes first.
I'm not volunteering. Want to swap and stay back?

events.name: Gus
events.text: My anchor power suits the wall stage, not the glass; here I just want to stay at the back so the front-runners test panes for me. Holding preserves that. Encourage front claims without committing.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm sitting tight at the back. Whoever 'knows' the path can prove it at the front - I'll follow the survivors.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash and Cole both claim knowledge, one may be lying, and I hold a forger power I should save. Front is risky; I'd rather not volunteer yet since the wall pressure is only 2 rounds out. Holding at 4th keeps options open for swaps later.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Still no proof from anyone. Ash and Cole, one of you is bluffing. Let's see who reveals a pane first before we reorder.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I am already front and know all safe sides; staying ensures I lead and survive.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I will step first and show the safe path for everyone.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I am Bex, and I have the feather power, which lets me survive one elimination. The bridge is dangerous, and the line order is critical. Ash and Cole are claiming to know the path, which is likely a bluff or a specific power. Hana is calling them out. My goal is to win a prize, wh

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm moving up. Let's see who's actually leading.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Wall advances next round, then crossing starts. I have the safe path so want to lead to prove and control. No swaps likely happening; better to volunteer to front now before push. Ash claims path too, likely faker or knows ahead power.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Time's up. I have map power & safe path. Volunteering to front now to lead us across perfectly.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole is bluffing about the map; he wants me to move forward so he can stay safe. If I volunteer, I become the front and face death immediately. Holding is safer as Ash and Cole are already ahead.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole, you keep whispering swap deals but never prove your 'map'. Ash, if you truly know every pane, volunteer now or step aside for someone who does. I’m holding until the wall forces action.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I should stay back and avoid breaking glass. Let others test first.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm safe at the back for now, but I need to think about how to use my power effectively when we get to the crusher room.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Let's wait and see who gets through the glass bridge first.
I'm not swapping with you, I'm safer at the back.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm last in line; the front-taker eats the risk each row, so staying at the back is safest. Fenn's swap would just shuffle mid-line, not help me. Wall pushes next round; keep position.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn, no deal — I'm staying at the back. Anyone claiming to know the path can lead and prove it.
I'm last; swapping with you moves me forward, not back. Hard pass. Stay cautious yourself.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I hold the forger power, which is valuable to save for a critical moment. Ash and Cole are both claiming to know the path; one is lying. I shouldn't step forward yet and risk dying; I'll hold and watch who reveals a pane.

events.name: Hana
events.text: No one has proven anything yet. I'll hold my place and watch who reveals a safe pane before anyone steps onto glass.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need to be front to guide safely and ensure my survival.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I have the glass eye: safe sides are L,R,L,L,L,R,L,R. Let me lead us across.

events.name: Bex
events.text: The wall is advancing and this is the last round before we hit the glass bridge. I need to be at the front to ensure I survive. Cole claims to have the map power, but Dara suspects him. My power is feather, which is a one-time survival, so I need to use it wisely. I will voluntee

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm moving to the front. Safety first!

events.name: Cole
events.text: Last round of waiting, wall pushes us onto glass next. Bex and I both volunteered last round; she was ahead so now front is Bex, me second, then others shifted. I have the map, so second position is good - if she fails row 1 I step safely and lead the rest perfectly. No need to v

events.name: Cole
events.text: Bex you're up front now with my volunteer support. I have map, you'll see me correct if you guess wrong later. Let's cross safely together.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole is currently at the front, and Bex is second. The wall pushes in 1 round (round 6/6 means this is the last wait). I am 5th. If Cole steps on glass next turn and dies, Bex becomes front. If Bex dies too, Ash becomes front. I need to be closer to safety or have someone take th

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole claims map power but hasn't proven it. The front risks death on row one; I don't want to volunteer. I'll hold and observe. Maybe someone reveals a safe pane before the wall forces action.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole, if you truly know the safe panes, step on the first row now and prove it. Otherwise step back and let someone who risks their life earn trust.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm Fenn with the wedge power, useless here. Need to stay safe and observe.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Let's see who steps first and how it goes.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm last in line with an anchor power that favors holding position. Bex and Cole are fighting for the front; let them take the glass risk. Staying at the back is strictly good for me.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Let the map-claimers lead. I'll hold my place at the back and cross on whatever path survives.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm a forger, not a bridge-scout, so I have no way to verify panes. Cole and Bex are at the front; holding my place at 4th keeps me alive for now while the wall pushes toward the glass. I should avoid volunteering blindly and watch who reveals a safe pane.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Holding. Whoever is at the front, reveal a pane before we commit; I'll follow the first verified safe path.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I have the safe sequence, but I am not front, so I must wait.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I am at the front of the line. Ash claims to have the glass eye power, which reveals safe panes. Cole claims to have a map, implying knowledge of safe panes. Eli is challenging Cole's claim. Hana wants proof before committing. Gus is content to follow. I need to choose a pane (L

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash, you said L is safe for the first pane. I'll trust you and step L.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Bex is front, Ash behind; both volunteered. Ash claims glass eye with L,R,L,L,L,R,L,R. I know full map from power, can verify if correct. Support Ash's claim publicly to build trust for later stages.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash's sequence matches what I see on map. Bex or Ash, step L first row. Trust the path.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I am at position 5 in the line, so I must wait. Ash claims to have glass-eye and gave a sequence L,R,L,L,L,R,L,R. Bex is now front after volunteering. I should not reveal my 'nothing' power yet.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Ash's sequence is interesting. Let's see if Bex trusts it or has her own info.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm not at the front, so I can only wait and gather information. Ash claimed to know the safe pattern, but hasn't proven it yet. I'll wait and see if Bex or Ash steps correctly, and assess whether to trust or bargain later.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Bex, you're at the front now. Show us you're worth trusting—pick a pane. I'll remember who bluffs.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm not at the front, so I can only wait. Ash claims to have the glass eye and is now at the front.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash, if you're sure about the safe panes, let's hear your next step.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm last in line with an anchor power that keeps me safe near the end. Let the front players reveal safe panes; I cross behind them with zero risk.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Front-runners, keep stepping. Each pane you reveal is free info for the rest of us—I'll be right behind.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm not at the front, so my only legal action is wait. Ash and Cole claim map knowledge, Bex is front; I should stay quiet and watch for verified information without committing.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I know row 2 safe side is R, so I should guide Bex to choose correctly and stay alive.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Bex, the safe side for this pane is R.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I am at the front of the line, and it's my turn to choose a pane. The previous row's weak pane was R. I need to choose L or R. My goal is to win, and ideally get 1st place. I have a feather power that can save me once from elimination. I need to assess the risk and make a decisio

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'll take the left pane.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Bex trusted Ash and stepped L, which was correct (R weak), so she stays front for row 2. Ash's path matched row 1; I endorsed it to build trust. I know full safe path but won't reveal yet to preserve my info value later.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Good step Bex, L safe row1 as Ash/Cole predicted. Ash, what's row2? Trust us frontrunners.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I have no power, so I must rely entirely on the information provided by others and my own logic. I am currently behind Eli, Fenn, and Gus. Since I cannot act directly yet, I need to gather intel. Cole mentioned an 'map', which suggests he might have the 'see through glass' or 'kn

events.name: Dara
events.text: Ash, you said L was safe for row 1, but R was the weak one. Did you know that? Or were you bluffing to test Bex?

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm not at the front, so I just wait. I can use this time to gather info and plan alliances or deception for later.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm not at the front, so I can only wait. I'll observe the others' decisions and try to gather information.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Bex, be careful, we don't know if Ash's info is reliable.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm last in line, so front-runners reveal safe panes for free as they die. My anchor power is passive—nothing to spend. Best play: stay quiet, let others test panes.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Row 1 is done: R was weak. Six rows left—plenty of front-runners ahead of me. I'll wait and watch.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm third in line, so I can only wait. Row 1's weak pane was R, which Bex stepped onto safely, so L is now known-safe for row 2 only if the pattern holds; I shouldn't trust unverified claims. My forger power is best saved for later.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Bex, row 1 weak was R, so you're through. Let's see if Ash's L claim holds on row 2 before anyone trusts it.

events.name: Bex
events.detail: The pane shattered but the feather held the holder up.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Inform Bex of the correct safe side to keep her alive and maintain front position for later rows.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Bex, the safe side for this pane is L.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I am at the front of the line. Row 2's left pane was weak. Ash previously said L was safe for row 1, but R was weak. Hana said Ash's L claim for row 2 might not hold. Given Ash's potential misdirection and the recent info about row 2, I should choose R to be safe.

events.name: Bex
events.text: R is the safe pane for row 2.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Bex survived row1 weak R despite saying left, suspicious - maybe survives fall power or glass see power and lied. She announced L before weak revealed, so probably sees glass and bluffed to test Ash. I know all ahead: row3 unknown to others. Line: Bex front survived row2? Wait no

events.name: Cole
events.text: Bex survived stepping L on row1? But R was weak so L safe, yet you announced L and survived row1 fine, but row2 L weak killed? Wait your row2 step? Suspicious survival. What's your plan row3?

events.name: Dara
events.text: Ash claimed R was safe for row 2, but L turned out to be the weak pane (meaning R was safe). So Ash's prediction for row 2 was correct. Bex survived by taking L on row 1 (weak was R) and is now at front for row 3. Cole claimed L safe row 1 (wrong) and asked Ash about row 2. If As

events.name: Dara
events.text: Interesting: Ash predicted R for row 2 correctly, while Cole failed row 1. Bex, you're up. Ash seems reliable.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm far back, no action now. I'll watch info and maybe gather whispers later, but for now just wait.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm not at the front, so I can only wait. Bex is at the front and has already made a decision for this row.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Bex, be cautious, we still don't know if Ash's info is reliable for row 2.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Row 2's weak pane (L) is revealed, so the front just steps R safely. Bex survived a shatter—likely the fall-survivor power. I'm last in line; staying quiet and observant is best.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Bex survived a shatter—note that, she may be the fall-survivor. Row 2's weak side was L, so the front can step R safely. I'll keep watching from the back.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm not at the front, so I can only wait. Bex survived row 2 but the log shows weak panes revealed; I should avoid making claims I can't verify and keep my forge power unspent for a better moment.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Waiting my turn. Bex, weak panes so far were R then L, so row 3 is a fresh gamble for you. Trust only what we see.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Row4 safe side is L per my power. I should step L to survive.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash got row1 L safe (announced wrong R weak but L worked), row2 R safe (announced wrong L for someone else?), row3 R weak so L safe. Ash now front for row4, should call it. No pattern evident, random. Keep pressure on Ash.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash row3 R weak confirmed, so L safe. You've been right when it counted for yourself, what's row4? Prove your info.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I am currently safe at position 4. I have no power, so survival is my only goal. I must remain silent and let the others take the risks ahead of me to avoid elimination.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm in the middle of the line, no risk this round. Bex died on row 3, so front is Ash on row 4. I'll stay quiet, watch what happens, maybe whisper to someone later.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm Fenn with the wedge power, not useful now. I need to observe and wait for opportunities.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Let's keep calm and cross the bridge.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm last in line with anchor footing for the ledge later. Ash has been accurate so far; no reason to spend influence. Just wait and track row 4's outcome.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash has called three rows correctly. I'd trust her again for row 4 unless proven wrong.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm not at the front; only wait is legal. Known weak panes: row1 R, row2 L, row3 R, so Ash's safe-pane claims have been unreliable. My forger power is best saved for a later, more useful moment.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Waiting my turn. Ash, we've seen weak panes R, L, R so far. Let's watch the pattern closely before the next step.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Row5 safe side is L per glass_eye knowledge.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash got row 4 wrong, R was weak so L safe, confirming pattern R,L,R,R weak. Next is row 5, I know the pattern from map. She's not prescient. Position good behind her, let her risk next.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash wrong again, row4 R weak so L safe. Pattern weak panes: row1 R,2 L,3 R,4 R. Ash, your info busted. Row5 next: what's your guess now?

events.name: Dara
events.text: I am fourth in line, so I can only wait and talk. Ash is currently the front agent facing row 5, which she hasn't called yet. Since I have no power to influence outcomes or fake messages, my best move is to remain silent or make a neutral comment to avoid drawing suspicion while

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm not at front, just wait. Ash has been right so far, but row 5 is unknown. I'll stay quiet and observe.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I am Fenn with the wedge power, which is useful later in the crusher room. For now, I just need to wait and observe.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Let's keep calm and cross the bridge.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash has been reliable; her survival helps me stay back in line with fewer deaths ahead. I should reinforce trust in her and probe who has foresight info, since I'm near the back with nothing revealed yet.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash nailed rows 1-4. Ash, keep calling — you've earned the front. Rest of us, no one should demand the front without proof.
You've been right every row. Keep leading and I'll back you to the end. Who do you think fed Cole his info?

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash is front and will decide row 5; I cannot act. Row 4 weak was R, so row 5 is unknown. My forger power could be used later but isn't needed now; staying quiet and waiting preserves my position.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Waiting for Ash's call on row 5. Let's see the result before anyone commits.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Row 6 safe side is R per my glass_eye knowledge. I must choose R to stay alive.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Row 5 weak R confirmed, so Ash wrong on row 5 too; her pattern info is busted. Now Hana's at front for row 6, the last one. With map knowledge I know full pattern but won't reveal yet, might need later.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash wrong on row5 too (R weak, L safe). Ash 0/5 now. Hana, your call on row6?

events.name: Dara
events.text: Ash failed row 5 (picked R, weak was R). The pattern of revealed weak panes is now [R, L, R, R, R]. I am at position 4. If Cole and Hana fail their turns before me, I will be front for row 6 or later. There are no more forced moves left; if everyone survives the remaining rows, w

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm not at the front, so I can only wait. Ash has been wrong about some weak panes, but I need to stay alert for later rounds. I'll stay quiet for now to avoid drawing attention.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm not at the front, so I can only wait. Ash has been doing well so far.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash has done a great job so far, let's keep trusting them.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Row 5 is resolved; I'm back of the line and my only legal action is wait. Ash has proven reliable at calling panes, so I publicly back them to keep coalition goodwill and avoid becoming a target later.

events.name: Gus

events.text: I'm stuck behind Hana and Dara, and the front is Ash. I can only wait. I'll stay silent and hope Ash picks right or dies so the next person goes safely.

events.text: I'm not at the front, so I can only wait. Ash has been wrong several times, so I'm not confident in their judgment.

events.text: Row 8 kills at most one, and I'm seventh in line — I survive regardless. No risk to manage here.

events.name: Gus
events.text: No more info to give on row 8 — I'm last and safe this row. Good luck, whoever steps.

events.text: I'm not at the front; only wait is legal. Ash has been wrong most rows, and rows 7 weak was R, so row 8 is unknown. Maximize survival by staying quiet and not provoking Ash to kill me. I'll stay silent.

events.text: I need to get a lever holder quickly; pushing Eli may force them to hold and let me escape.

Eli, you're reliable from bridge. Consider hold_lever this round? Others can escape, you get 25% shot. If not, I'll push you next.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Let's see what others do first.

I can't be pushed onto the lever (anchor power). If you ever need a guaranteed safe partner, I'm the one. Don't push me, it fails.

events.name: Eli

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I should choose a tile and hope it's not a trapdoor. Others' choices may give me an idea.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Let's spread out, choosing different tiles.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Tiles open randomly after round 2; no info advantage this round. Anchor doesn't help here. Just pick any tile; collisions get bumped randomly anyway. I'll stay quiet to avoid attention.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Tiles are random trapdoors; choice doesn't change odds per tile, but avoiding collisions matters. Others may cluster; I pick an outlying tile to reduce bumps.

events.text: I'm on tile 1 and have the wedge power, but it's not useful here. I should try to move to a safer tile.

Swap with me, I'm on tile 1.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Tiles are known now. I'll wait; my anchor power doesn't help against trapdoors. Staying quiet avoids becoming a swap target.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Trapdoors open at random after this round, so position doesn't matter; only the forger power is valuable, and I should save it. Stay quiet or reassure allies, and avoid giving away my power.
